name: Pay bill
description: The caller wants to pay a bill to a company: company name, amount and company address.

gate.question: Is this a bill-payment call: does the caller want to pay a bill to a company?

fields.model_hint: The company the caller wants to pay.
The amount the caller wants to pay, as a number.
The company's address the caller gives.

steps.name: Greet and open
steps.description: State the bank name and your own name, then ask how you can help.
steps.example_phrase: Hello, this is Harper Valley National Bank, my name is Jennifer. How can I help you today?
steps.done_when: The agent names the bank and gives their own name, then asks how they can help.

steps.name: Collect company name
steps.description: Get which company is being paid, by asking or by confirming.
steps.example_phrase: Which company would you like to pay?
steps.done_when: The agent has the company name from the caller.

steps.name: Collect payment amount
steps.description: Get how much to pay, by asking or by confirming.
steps.example_phrase: How much would you like to pay?
steps.done_when: The agent has the amount from the caller.

steps.name: Collect company address
steps.description: Get the company's address, by asking or by confirming.
steps.done_when: The agent has the company address from the caller.

steps.name: Log the bill payment
steps.description: Log the task type, company name, amount and address.

sub_checks.description: The agent logged the task type 'pay bill'
The logged company name matches what the caller said
The logged amount matches what the caller said
The logged address matches what the caller said

steps.done_when: The agent logged the right task type and values.

steps.name: Offer further help
steps.description: Ask whether the caller needs anything else.
steps.example_phrase: Is there anything else I can help you with?
steps.done_when: The agent asks whether the caller needs anything else.

steps.name: Close
steps.description: Thank the caller and end the call.
steps.example_phrase: Thank you for calling, you have a great day.
steps.done_when: The agent thanks the caller or says goodbye before the call ends.
